stemMd: A rectangle is divided into 3 equal rows and 4 equal columns. One entire row and one entire column are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
explanationMd: The row shades four cells and the column three, with one shared cell. Thus 4+3−1=6 of the twelve cells are shaded, giving one half. Inclusion-exclusion handles the overlap.

distractorRationale.e: This counts the overlapping cell twice.
distractorRationale.b: This counts only the shaded row.
distractorRationale.a: This counts only the shaded column.
